name: cos
description: A chief of staff you talk to through Carbon Voice. Keeps a notebook of your focus, actions, what you're waiting on, projects, people, decisions and ideas, that you can see on one page or open in Obsidian. Sends a morning brief and tidies its notes nightly. Set up with the one-line installer (see the README, or run /cos:setup for directions); check health with /cos:doctor.
